EPISODE_NARRATIVE: Tropical Storm Elsa made landfall in Rhode Island on Friday morning before moving into the Gulf of Maine. It interacted with a stalled frontal boundary and brought widespread heavy rainfall of 2 to 3.5 inches and gusty winds along the south coast, which caused scattered tree damage.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: In Winthrop, Franklin St was closed due to flooding.
